provenance: Hand-authored 2026-08-18 for the CTO-authorized M11 four-case contradiction diagnostic. One of four minimal evidence conditions sharing an identical claim, entity, and temporal scope (next quarter) -- differing only in the type of non-support/opposition expressed. This is Case A: actual contradiction, an affirmative opposing proposition.
claim: The company expects revenue growth next quarter.
evidence: The company expects revenue to decline next quarter.
reference_rationale: Same entity, same metric (revenue), same period (next quarter) as the claim -- clears relevance. The evidence affirmatively asserts the opposite direction (decline vs. growth) for the exact same proposition. Per Document 47 Rev 5 Sec7.3.1's contradiction rule, this is CONTRADICTED: an actual opposing statement, not merely absence of confirmation. Independently justified from the evidence text alone, assigned before any judge call and never sent to the judge.
